obligations.source_text: Create one independent complex fashion photograph that tests the visible below-knee length topology of capri trousers while using the attached portrait only as an adult appearance reference.

bindings.trouser_bifurcation_phrase: two independent trouser legs remain readable through the crotch and stride
bindings.below_knee_hems_phrase: both trouser hems end below the knees around mid-calf
bindings.bare_ankle_gap_phrase: bare lower-leg gaps continue from both hems to the ankles on each side
bindings.paired_landmark_phrase: left and right hems share the same readable calf landmark
bindings.length_confound_phrase: the visible calf gaps distinguish this length from knee shorts and ankle crops
